newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Norwich Australia funds grow 24 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Norwich Australia funds grow 24 pct in 1996.

text.p: Australian fund manager Norwich Union Financial Services Group said on Thursday its funds under management rose 24 percent to A$5.1 billion in the year to December 31, 1996 from A$4.1 billion in 1995.
"Good progress is being made with improvement initiatives in our life insurance business while our investment business is growing strongly," said Norwich Union group managing director Peter Jonson.
Norwich is wholly-owned by the Norwich Union Group of Britain.
The group gained more than A$20 million in new wholesale mandates in 1996 with 27 percent of its funds under management now wholesale, Jonson said.
Jonson said Norwich's acquisition of 50 percent of Australian fund manager GRW Ltd in August last year had further expanded the group's skills base and expertise in property investment.
GRW is the manager of the listed National Industrial Property Trust.
"There was strong downward pressure on profit margins in life insurance in 1996 and higher than expected claims," Jonson said.
Jonson said Norwich's decision not to write marginal life insurance business had weakened its 1996 new business result but was expected to pay dividends in the period ahead.
